Octopus energy hold MPRN 7702485000 with Xoserve address 201, (PLOT 7), SUTTON PARK ROAD, SUTTON GOLDINGS, KIDDERMINSTER, WORCESTERSHIRE, DY11 6LE and have confirmed their customers billing address as 202 Sutton Park Road, Kidderminster, Worcestershire, DY11 6LE. As you MPRN in Xoserve has an address of 202, (PLOT 9), SUTTON PARK ROAD, KIDDERMINSTER, WORCESTERSHIRE, DY11 6LE, can you please confirm your customers billing address as we may need to agree an address amendment to Xoserve.
